About Gao’s Bbq Houston

If you're looking for a taste of authentic Chinese BBQ in Houston, Gao’s BBQ Houston should be on your list. Located at 9888 Bellaire Blvd #118, Houston, TX, this vibrant restaurant offers a memorable dining experience that will satisfy both your cravings and your desire for something unique.

The restaurant specializes in traditional Chinese BBQ, and their kabobs are a crowd favorite. Many visitors rave about the perfectly grilled lamb kabobs, which can be enjoyed during happy hour at just $1 per skewer. If you're bringing kids along, you’ll be pleased to know they offer free kids' meals, making it a great option for family dining. The menu also features other flavorful skewers like beef and vegetable, which are consistently praised for being both tender and flavorful.

Aside from the food, the atmosphere at Gao’s BBQ is lively and fun, with the addition of karaoke that enhances the dining experience. While some find the music to be a bit loud, it doesn’t overwhelm the conversation, creating an upbeat vibe that many customers enjoy. The friendly staff ensures that diners are well taken care of, regularly checking in to make sure everything is to your liking.

The milk tea served at Gao’s is another highlight, offering a refreshing complement to the savory BBQ dishes. With a welcoming atmosphere, attentive service, and a great selection of food and drinks, Gao’s BBQ Houston is a fantastic spot for anyone in the area looking to enjoy a delicious, authentic Chinese BBQ meal. Whether you're a local or just passing through, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit!

Reviews

“ The barbecue is absolutely delicious! The ingredients are fresh, and the grilling is done to perfection. The seasoning is well-balanced, enhancing the natural flavors without overpowering them. Whether it’s meat or vegetables, every bite carries a rich. It’s so good that you just can’t stop eating! ”

Bairong Wu

“ Gao’s Kabob & Crab was a great experience. I ordered the beef and vegetable skewers, and both were cooked perfectly and full of flavor. We were seated quickly, and the staff was very friendly and checked on us often. The atmosphere was lively — the karaoke was a little loud, but not overwhelming. The milk tea was also delicious. I’ll definitely be coming back! ”

Bruce Williams

“ GAO’s BBQ serves some of the best grilled food I’ve ever had — full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The manager Jason is amazing — super friendly, professional, and yes, very handsome! Great food and great vibes. Highly recommended! ”

Peggy

“ Variety, bold flavors, an experience. Great date spot and night out with friends and/or family. Don't be shy in ordering when you are in the heart of Chinatown Houston! ”

Luke Goldrich

“ We don't have any shaokao restaurants near us so when we saw this place we decided to stop by while in Houston. Such a great decision! Almost forgot to take a picture of the food since I was devouring it. Stop by for happy hour kabobs at 1 per lamb kabob and they even had free kids meals. ”

Aaron Becerra

“ Gao is the best authentic Chinese bbq in Houston. Really enjoyed the music they are playing. If you ever visit, be sure to check out this place! ”

Qianying Lu

“ Food was amazing! Service was excellent very friendly and they take good care of us very well ambiance was clean and just about right. ”

Rina Huynh

“ Everything we ate was amazing! The staff are really friendly and helpful. Definitely will come back! ”

Jill Goehring - Houston Realtor

Gao’s Bbq Houston

Gao’s Bbq Houston offers a diverse range of options from delicious skewers to flavorful small plates. Located in Houston, TX, this restaurant provides no-contact delivery, takeout, and dine-in services. Enjoy fast service and a variety of drinks including cocktails and beer. Join for lunch or dinner and indulge in their popular menu items such as Grilled Big Lamb Skewers and Black Pepper Beef Fillet Skewers. With wheelchair-accessible facilities and free parking, this is a convenient spot for locals and tourists alike. Don't miss their monthly specials and free kids meals. Come experience the best authentic Chinese BBQ in town at Gao’s Bbq Houston.
